question.text: The maximum probability of finding electron in the <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow></msub></math> orbital is:

options.text: at the angle of  <math><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ο</mi></mrow></msup></math>  from the x-and y-axis
at the angle of  <math><mn>9</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ο</mi></mrow></msup></math>  from the x-and y-axis

solution.text: The maximum probability of finding electron in the dxy orbital lies at the angle of 45ο from the x-and y-axis.
